name: zfmv_playback_open_and_play
description: zFMV_Playback::OpenAndPlay flushes DirectDraw to GDI, opens an MPEGVideo MCI device, optionally applies source/destination rectangles, sets millisecond time format/audio, and starts playback with optional notify/end bounds.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x462370 calls zVideo_dd::FlipToGDIIfAttached, loads the imported mciSendCommandA provider once, opens device type "MPEGVideo" with self->mediaPathDup using command 0x803 and flags 0x2202, stores the returned low-word device id at self+0x04, and binds self->notifyHwnd with command 0x841 and flags 0x10002.

When mciPutFlags has 0x40000 it sends command 0x842 with flags 0x50002 and a destination rectangle encoded as left, top, right-left, bottom-top. When mciPutFlags has 0x20000 it sends command 0x842 with flags 0x30002 and the same shape for sourceRect.

It sends MCI_SET command 0x811 with flags 0x302, timeFormat 0x1b, and audio set to notifyHwnd, then sends MCI_PLAY command 0x806 with dwFrom=startMs, base flags 0x6, optional dwTo/end flag 0xe when endMs is nonnegative, and optional notify flag 0x10000 only when notifyFlag equals 1.

Every nonzero MCI result except the initial open result reports through zFMV_Playback::ReportMciError and returns immediately; a nonzero open result is reported but execution continues and uses the provider-filled device id.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification passes under the zfmv_playback_methods target.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x462370 passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches under vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs; BN size 382, VC object symbol size 384, 20 COFF relocation-masked bytes, and 2 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
